documents.title: Elsema Replacement Guide: FMT-204, FMT-304, FMT-404 and KEY-304 superseded by Penta PCK43304 / FOB43304
documents.evidence: On elsema.com, the manufacturer's own domain. Typed SERVICE_BULLETIN because that is what it is - a supersession notice, not an installation manual. It states that the FMT-204, FMT-304, FMT-404 and KEY-304 are replaced by the Penta PCK43304 or FOB43304. Recorded because a discontinued-part notice is exactly what a technician holding a dead remote needs, and it is the kind of document a catalogue of manuals usually loses. The superseded part numbers are aliases so a search for any of them lands here. Not fetched - egress blocked.
